mechanism_comparison.standard_core: Kernel inclusion ker C subset ker R makes R constant on fibers of C, hence R factors uniquely through range(C); therefore rank(R) <= rank(C).
mechanism_comparison.local_delta: The formal interface states the abstract obstruction at division-ring generality. A separate Lean theorem excludes finite separable representations of the literal three-prime kernel using arbitrary-order nonsingular minors. The source snapshot does not package the identification between these two interfaces as one Lean theorem.
mechanism_comparison.observer_boundary: In control theory, observability concerns recovery of states from an output trajectory generated by system dynamics. The card's C is only a static linear compression unless extra dynamics are supplied.
mechanism_comparison.automata_boundary: Finite Hankel rank and recognizable-series theorems require word shifts or a monoid representation. The bare abstract theorem is more general but correspondingly more elementary.
mechanism_comparison.significance_boundary: The result is a reusable semantic guard and no-go interface, not a new realization theorem.
